17887769265415248.caption:
Five days out, and we want to tell you why we picked a carabiner as the centerpiece of this whole night. 🏳️‍🌈

It's a small piece of hardware most of us carry without thinking twice. But look closer and it's actually a tiny engineering marvel — a loop that opens just wide enough to let something new in, then locks tight enough to never let it go. That's a pretty perfect metaphor for the kind of spaces we're trying to build at Azúcar: open enough for anyone to step into, strong enough that once you're part of this community, you're held.

This Sunday, July 12th from 7–10 PM, you'll get to pick your own carabiner, build it out with charms — think tiny florals, rainbow hearts, cowgirl boots, star charms, and a few surprises we're not spoiling yet — and walk away with something that's part accessory, part memory, part inside joke with whoever's sitting next to you at the craft table.

And here's the part that matters most: every single dollar raised goes directly toward funding our upcoming Sapphic events. So when you clip that carabiner to your bag, you're not just showing off your bedazzling skills — you're wearing proof that you helped build something bigger.

$10 at the door. Doors open at 7 PM.

📍 327 W Lewis St, Pasco, WA

🔔🎊 Midweek check-in: are you ready?! 

Because Latino/a Pride is just 9 DAYS AWAY and we are getting more excited by the hour! Azucar @ Out & About, 327 W Lewis St in Pasco, June 13th starting at 4pm. 

This is the celebration that our community has been waiting for — an event that puts the Latino LGBTQ+ experience front and center and says YES, we are here, YES we are proud, and YES we are throwing the biggest, most joyful party Pasco has seen. 

But this isn’t just for the LGBTQ+ community — this is for EVERYONE. 

Your straight friends? Invite them. Your family members who are still learning but showing up? Bring them. Your coworkers who love live music and local vendors? Tell them. 

This is a space where everyone is welcome, everyone is respected, and everyone can have the time of their life. 9 days, Pasco. Who are you bringing? Tag them below! 👇🎊🌈

🔔🎊 ¡Control de mitad de semana: estás listo/a?! ¡Porque el Orgullo Latino/a está a solo 9 DÍAS y nos emocionamos más cada hora! Azucar @ Out & About, 327 W Lewis St en Pasco, 13 de junio a partir de las 4pm. 

Esta es la celebración que nuestra comunidad ha estado esperando — un evento que pone la experiencia LGBTQ+ Latina al frente y al centro y dice SÍ, estamos aquí, SÍ estamos orgullosos, y SÍ estamos organizando la fiesta más grande y alegre que Pasco haya visto. Pero esto no es solo para la comunidad LGBTQ+ — esto es para TODOS. 

¿Tus amigos heterosexuales? Invítalos. ¿Los miembros de tu familia que aún están aprendiendo pero apareciendo? Tráelos. ¿Tus compañeros de trabajo que aman la música en vivo y los vendedores locales? Díselo.

BIG HAIR, BIG HEARTS & A WHOLE LOT OF LOVE! 

From La Familia Azúcar, THANK YOU! 🌈✨
Our Dolly Parton Drag Show Fundraiser was filled with laughter, fabulous performances, dancing, and most importantly, a community coming together to make a difference.
TOGETHER, WE RAISED $650! 
But this night wouldn't have been possible without the incredible people who stepped up and made it happen!
We want to give an EXTRA SPECIAL THANK YOU to VictoriaDeMizer, whose dedication, leadership, and heart helped bring this beautiful fundraiser to life.
And a huge round of applause for our fabulous performers Cherry Pop, Puddlezz, Zero, and Bea! Thank you for sharing your talent, creativity, time, and energy to make this night unforgettable!
A very special thank-you also goes to José from Cabana Bass for being part of this wonderful effort and helping make it all possible!
You didn't just put on a show. You brought people together for a purpose. And that deserves to be celebrated! 
We're proud to share that the $650 raised will be donated to two wonderful causes:

♥️Dolly Parton's Imagination Library, helping put books into the hands of children right here in Benton and Franklin Counties.
❤️ WAISN Worker Collective, supporting and uplifting members of our community.

Because isn't that exactly what Dolly would have done? Spread kindness, lift others up, and use whatever spotlight you have to make the world a little brighter.
To everyone who showed up, bought a drink, tipped a queen, danced, laughed, or simply came to support 

THANK YOU!

At Azúcar, we're more than just a nightclub. We're a familia. And nights like this remind us that when our community comes together, we can have an amazing time while making a meaningful difference.
A little country, a lot of glitter, and a whole lot of HEART! 

With all our love and gratitude,
LA FAMILIA AZÚCAR

It’s a day that says: our culture is beautiful, our identities are valid, and our community is STRONG. And it’s a day that extends a hand to every single person who wants to be part of that. 

Live performances, live music all afternoon, 15+ vendors to explore, and a night dance party to end the evening on the highest possible note.

Six days from tonight, Azúcar is turning into a crafting wonderland. 🌈🔑

We're calling it Build Your Own Carabiner Night, but really, it's an excuse to get our community in one room, hands busy, hearts open, and music playing while we make something to carry with us long after the night ends.

Here's the thing about a carabiner — it's built to hold things together. A ring for your keys, a clip for your bag, a small piece of hardware that keeps what matters close. We loved that symbolism enough to build an entire night around it, because that's what we're trying to do as a community too: hold each other, hold space, and hold on to the connections we've built all summer long.

On Sunday, July 12th from 7–10 PM, grab a carabiner, pick your charms, and build something that's completely, unapologetically you. Come solo and leave with new friends, or bring your whole crew and make a night of it. Either way, you're not just building an accessory — you're building community.

Tickets are $10 at the door, and every dollar goes toward funding our upcoming Sapphic events. Mark your calendar, because this one's going to fill up fast.

Born from the heart of the Latino LGBTQ+ experience, this event is a love letter to every queer Latino and Latina who has ever had to fight to be seen — and a welcome mat for every single person who wants to witness and share in that joy. 

We’ll have live performances lighting up the stage, live music that will move you from the inside out, over 15 local vendors to explore and support, and a night dance party that turns the evening into something magical.

Habrá presentaciones en vivo iluminando el escenario, música en vivo que te moverá desde adentro hacia afuera, más de 15 vendedores locales para explorar y apoyar, y una fiesta de baile nocturna que convierte la noche en algo mágico.

A New Chapter Begins: Introducing Azúcar at Out and About! 

After 29 incredible years as "Out and About," we're embracing the future with a fresh look, new energy, and a bold new name: Azúcar at Out and About!

This isn't about leaving the past behind—it's about celebrating our history, our community, and refreshing our beloved space to keep the spirit alive for generations to come. Azúcar isn't just sugar—it's an homage to Afro-Latina legend Celia Cruz, whose joyous cry "¡Azúcar!" inspired people across the Americas to dance, celebrate, and live boldly.

 What's New? 

 Multiple dance floors with diverse beats—from iconic pop hits on our industrial dance floor to lively norteñas, rancheras, and Latin rhythms in our dedicated Latino room.

 Spaces designed to build community, connection, and unforgettable memories—some rooms with NO COVER, so everyone can join the dance!

 A tribute to the legacy and diversity of our Eastern Washington community, honoring those who built and sustained "Out and About," while warmly welcoming everyone into our evolving space.

We can't wait to celebrate this exciting new chapter with you! Join us for a series of unforgettable grand openings featuring beloved drag queens, community celebrations, and endless dancing.

Here's to the next 29 years of music, community, and joy.

Come dance with us —¡Azúcar!

18064724029641607.caption:
We're excited to announce that we have officially purchased Out and About, a cherished LGBTQ+ bar that has stood as a beacon of community and belonging in the Tri-Cities for the past 25 years. This space carries a rich history, built by those who came before us, who fought for the right to gather, celebrate, and thrive openly. We honor their legacy and their struggles that helped create this sanctuary, and it is with deep gratitude that we now carry the torch to keep it alive.
As a Latino gay couple, my husband and I are committed to preserving Out and About as a welcoming, safe space for the LGBTQ+ community here in Eastern Washington. While we make a few updates to refresh the bar, we ask for your patience and trust in us to uphold its legacy. Together, we will ensure that this space remains a diverse and vibrant hub where everyone can feel seen, heard, and embraced for years to come. Stay tuned for updates as we look forward to a grand reopening and the continued strength of our community.
If you have any memories and or pictures of the history of Out and About, please share them below ❤️

18078904796647477.caption:
🌈✨ THREE MORE DAYS until Latino/a Pride in Pasco and we are in full celebration mode! 

Azucar @ Out & About, 327 W Lewis St, June 13th — doors open at 4pm and the fun does not stop. 

We want to take a moment to say what this event truly means to us. Latino/a Pride was created to give the Latino LGBTQ+ community a place to exist loudly and joyfully, to see their identities reflected in the faces around them, and to celebrate without apology. 

In a world that doesn’t always make space for queer Latino voices, we are making that space — right here in Pasco. And we’re inviting everyone to share in it. 

Allies, families, friends, people from every walk of life — if you come with love and an open heart, you are home. Live performances, live music, 15+ vendors, and a night dance party await. 

All ages until 9pm. Three days. Get your outfit ready. Get your squad together. This is going to be everything. 💃🔥💛

🌈✨ ¡TRES DÍAS MÁS hasta el Orgullo Latino/a en Pasco y estamos en modo celebración total! 

Azucar @ Out & About, 327 W Lewis St, 13 de junio — las puertas abren a las 4pm y la diversión no para. Queremos tomar un momento para decir lo que este evento realmente significa para nosotros. 

El Orgullo Latino/a fue creado para darle a la comunidad LGBTQ+ Latina un lugar para existir en voz alta y con alegría, para ver sus identidades reflejadas en los rostros a su alrededor, y para celebrar sin disculpas. 

En un mundo que no siempre hace espacio para las voces queer Latinas, estamos creando ese espacio — aquí mismo en Pasco. Y estamos invitando a todos a compartirlo. 

Aliados, familias, amigos, personas de todos los ámbitos de la vida — si vienes con amor y un corazón abierto, estás en casa. 

Presentaciones en vivo, música en vivo, más de 15 vendedores, y una fiesta de baile nocturna te esperan. Todas las edades hasta las 9pm. 

Tres días. Prepara tu outfit. Reúne a tu grupo. Esto lo va a ser todo. 💃🔥💛

📍 327 W Lewis St, Pasco | 🗓️ June 13 / 13 de junio, 2026 | ⏰ 4pm | All ages until 9pm / Todas las edades hasta las 9pm
#3Days #3Días #LatinoPride #OrgulloLatino #Pasco #Azucar #PridePasco2026 #OrgulloPasco2026

Folklórico royalty, right here at home 👢

For the very first time at Azúcar, we get to welcome Ballet Folklórico Cielo de México to our Pride stage. This is a local Tri Cities treasure, a crew of five to ten dancers bringing the traditional dances of northern México to life with the skirts, the boots, and the zapateado that you feel in your chest.

These dancers perform all throughout the year, and their famous annual showcase is honestly one of the most beautiful things you can experience locally. If you have never seen it, put it on your list, because it is the kind of show people talk about for weeks afterward. For now, we are lucky enough to have them at Azúcar, and we could not be more proud to share our stage with them.

They also teach all ages, so if watching them makes you want to learn, they are the ones to find. Come celebrate culture that lives and breathes right here at home.

💖🌵 FOUR DAYS, Pasco! Four days until Latino/a Pride takes over Azucar @ Out & About at 327 W Lewis St and we honestly can barely contain ourselves! 

This event is something we are incredibly proud of — a celebration designed to uplift and center the Latino LGBTQ+ community, to give our queer gente a day that is fully and completely theirs. 

Pride in your identity. Pride in your culture. Pride in who you love and who you are. And if you’re not part of the LGBTQ+ community yourself, we still want you here — we NEED you here. 

Because the best kind of celebration is one where the whole community shows up together, for each other. We’ve got live performances lined up that will absolutely blow you away, live music all afternoon and into the evening, over 15 amazing local vendors, and a night dance party to end things on a high.

Orgullo en a quién amas y en quién eres. Y si no eres parte de la comunidad LGBTQ+ tú mismo, aún te queremos aquí — te NECESITAMOS aquí. 

Porque el mejor tipo de celebración es aquella donde toda la comunidad se presenta junta, la una por la otra. Tenemos presentaciones en vivo preparadas que absolutamente te dejarán boquiabierto, música en vivo toda la tarde y hasta la noche, más de 15 increíbles vendedores locales, y una fiesta de baile nocturna para terminar en lo más alto.

That’s exactly what Latino/a Pride is going to feel like on June 13th at Azucar @ Out & About in Pasco. Come dance.
